datasheet_identity.title: MM1Z2V0 THRU MM1Z75 SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: Zener-voltage limits are 11.4 V minimum and 12.7 V maximum at IZT = 5 mA and TA = 25 degC; the strict schema records the nominal value as breakdown_voltage.
Maximum zener impedance is 35 ohm at IZT = 5 mA.
The datasheet publishes no target-specific tabulated capacitance or reverse-recovery time.
The zener curve points are direct readings from the labelled 12 V trace in Fig. 2, not interpolated or fitted.
